updates.name: Oscar M. Schofield
updates.bio: Biological oceanographer and Distinguished Professor at Rutgers, chairing the Department of Marine and Coastal Sciences and co-directing the Center of Ocean Observing Leadership. Studies phytoplankton physiology and ecology along the warming West Antarctic Peninsula and the U.S. Northeast shelf, and develops ocean observing technology including gliders and radars. Lead PI of Palmer Antarctica LTER.

updates.name: Paul C. Hanson
updates.bio: Distinguished Research Professor at the UW-Madison Center for Limnology. Studies how lakes and reservoirs respond to climate, land use and human pressures, focusing on ecosystem-scale water quality, and pioneered ecology knowledge-guided machine learning. Involved in GLEON, the Environmental Data Initiative and North Temperate Lakes LTER.
